display_long_description:
DeoVR Hyper is the largest distribution platform for VR end users, empowering creators by supporting all major VR video formats and providing direct access to the broadest base of VR users.

🎬 For Creators
Reach the largest base of active VR users and distribute your work with ease. DeoVR Hyper provides creators with the tools to showcase high-quality 180, 360, and interactive VR videos, ensuring your immersive projects are displayed exactly as intended.

📽️ Support for modern VR video formats
Watch mono and stereo content across flat. This app is built for today’s VR video standards so creators can publish confidently and viewers always get the intended experience.

🕶️ Passthrough and comfortable viewing
Blend virtual video with your real room using passthrough for a more natural way to watch VR content. Adjust projection, scale and viewing angle to match your comfort preferences.

🎛️ Focused, intuitive interface
Navigate your library, pick a video and start watching in just a few clicks. The interface stays minimal and consistent so you can focus on the content, whether you are watching a quick clip or a full feature.

🔮 Future-ready VR video platform
The app is evolving with new capabilities, including local playback for videos stored on your headset, volumetric content you can move around in, and Build Your Own Journey  for interactive, branching video experiences.

Download DeoVR Hyper and turn your headset into a dedicated home.

This release is a beta version.
